newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo Bus in running for Australia deal.
newsitem.headline: Volvo Bus in running for Australia deal.

text.p: The bus division of Swedish vehicle maker AB Volvo said on Wednesday it was in the running for an order from Sydney Transport Authority for about 600 buses, a contract valued at about 1.1 billion crowns.
"There is a public tender for 300 complete buses with an option for another 300," a company spokesman told Reuters.
"The result is expected in the next few weeks."
Volvo last year won a large bus order from Sydney, has 400 of its buses on the road in Brisbane and hopes that Perth will be next, business daily Dagens Industri said.
Dagens Industri said Volvo this summer landed a high-profile order from Coca-Cola in Australia for 25 trucks worth about 12-15 million crowns.
